name: SurplusIQ Broward Docket Bridge
description: Local-run helper for SurplusIQ. Drives the Broward Clerk case search in genuine Chrome (Turnstile issues its token to a real browser) and hands the docket back to the local runner over 127.0.0.1. Load unpacked into the broward-fl profile; used only by `python -m core.dockets.broward`.
